children: Craig-Hallum initiated coverage of Fossil Group
Analyst Jeremy Hamblin highlighted that Fossil

is in the early stages of a turnaround that is focused on stabilizing sales and driving margin expansion. The fashion design and manufacturing company is seen laying the foundation for EBITDA to grow 6X over the next three years.

The first phase of the turnaround is centered on right-sizing the cost structure. SKU simplification, lower promotions, store rationalization, cost reductions, reducing SG&A by over $100M, and driving a $32M rise in EBITDA in one year. The second phase is expected to see a return to growth with EBITDA margins gaining ~1,500 basis points. Notably, Fossil
expects a return to top-line growth in Q4 while leveraging a structurally leaner cost base, according to Hamblin.
